How to Use Your Planner

A few tips to get the most out of your weekly reset.

Print It
  • Print on standard 20lb or 24lb paper (24lb recommended for writing quality)
  • Select "Actual Size" or "Fit to Page" in your printer settings
  • Enable "Background Graphics" to print colors and shading
  • Set margins to "None" for best results
  • Use a hole punch to add pages to a binder, or staple into a booklet
Use It Digitally
  • Import the PDF into your favorite tablet app for handwriting
  • Works beautifully with GoodNotes, Notability, and Noteshelf
  • Use the Table of Contents to jump between pages (hyperlinked)
  • Annotate with the Apple Pencil, Samsung S Pen, or any stylus
  • Duplicate pages weekly for reuse without reprinting
Tips for Your Best Week
  • Set aside 15-20 minutes on Sunday evening for your weekly reset
  • Start with the Brain Detox page to clear your head before planning
  • Fill in your Non-Negotiables first — everything else flows from there
  • Don't try to fill every line. White space is breathing room
  • Use the Bonus Stickers page to mark priorities or reward completed tasks
  • End the week with the Reflection page to celebrate wins (big and small)
This planner is yours. There are no rules — only what works for you.

Home Reset Checklist

A clean space, a clear mind.

Kitchen
Clear & wipe counters
Wash dishes / empty dishwasher
Clean out fridge
Prep meals or plan takeout
Take out trash
Living Spaces
10-minute tidy (each room)
Fluff pillows & fold blankets
Wipe down surfaces
Light a candle or diffuse oils
Bedroom
Change bed sheets
Clear nightstand
Put away clean laundry
Set out tomorrow's outfit
Bathroom
Wipe mirrors & counters
Restock toiletries
Wash towels
Quick floor wipe
Life Admin
Check calendar for the week
Reply to important messages
Set one intention for the week
"You don't have to do it all. Just do what resets you."
